title: DHX15 as a novel immune-related prognostic biomarker in breast cancer: An integrated bioinformatics analysis withfunctional validation.
snippet: Breast cancer (BC) is a disease that occurs relatively frequently, and its prognosis and treatment outcomes are not optimal at present. Identifying novel BC biomarkers and therapeutic targets is key. DEAH-box helicase 15 (DHX15) is an RNA helicase that exhibits enhanced activity and is closely associated with tumorigenic potential.
